assumptions.choice: 200-period daily SMA trend filter not implemented
assumptions.reason: Listed as optional-for-confirmation in the indicators section, not among the four numbered entry conditions, and requires a daily timeframe not derivable from the single 1h ES data feed provided by the harness.

assumptions.choice: NVDA ATH filter (entry condition 4) not implemented
assumptions.reason: Explicitly marked optional and requires NVDA price data, which is not provided (harness supplies only a single ES=F feed).

assumptions.choice: logic runs on the provided 1h bars as-is
assumptions.reason: Spec calls for 4h+ timeframes, but the harness fixes a single 1h data feed; resampling is not controllable from within the Strategy class.
Requires an external NVDA earnings calendar not derivable from OHLCV data.

assumptions.choice: pullback flagged when low[0] <= 6430.75; recovery confirmed on a later bar where close[0] > close[-1]
assumptions.reason: Spec states a pullback-then-recovery sequence but does not define an exact trigger; used the simplest literal one-bar confirmation.

assumptions.choice: 20-period simple moving average of volume; 'increased' means current volume above this average
assumptions.reason: Spec requires 'increased volume' at breakout/reversal but specifies no lookback period.

assumptions.choice: close[0] < open[0] and close[0] < close[-1] and volume[0] > 20-period volume SMA
assumptions.reason: Spec names a 'bearish candlestick pattern on increased volume' without defining a specific pattern; used the simplest literal down-bar-on-above-average-volume reading.

assumptions.choice: evaluated against bar close, not intrabar high/low
assumptions.reason: Spec does not specify intrabar vs. close-based triggers; close-based checks keep all conditions internally consistent.
Spec gives a 1-2% range without pinning an exact figure; chose the conservative end.

assumptions.choice: assume $1 of account value per point per unit (no futures multiplier)
assumptions.reason: Harness's fixed cerebro setup specifies no contract multiplier or margin scheme, so backtrader's default cash-per-unit-price behavior was used.

assumptions.choice: pullback/recovering state persists until an entry occurs or a trade closes; no time/price expiration
assumptions.reason: Spec does not define when a detected pullback/recovery becomes stale; avoided inventing unstated invalidation rules.
